# The pinned sources of VK-GL-CTS: each release's tarball and the external
# sources its external/fetch_sources.py names that the build of deqp-vk and
# glcts reads, each at the commit that file pins. A line gives a name,
# version, URL and SHA-256, in the format of ../sources.txt; a name ends in
# the release it belongs to, and the other names are the directories under
# external/ that fetch_sources.py would clone them into. build_vk_gl_cts.sh
# fetches and checks each with ../debian/fetch_asset.sh.
#
# GitHub signs none of these archives. The release tarballs are GitHub's
# archives of the tags vulkan-cts-1.4.1.1 and vulkan-cts-1.4.7.1, and the
# others its archives of the commits; each digest was recorded from the
# archive as GitHub served it on 2026-11-10, and 1.4.7.1's tarball has the
# 71,319,922 bytes that the second discovery run built on the Lenovo.
